records.excerpt: The official Ofsted inspection-report service searches schools, colleges, childminders, nurseries, children homes and other providers in England using name, URN or keyword and location or postcode, with provider-category filters.
records.web_line_scope: official page lines 4-85; search purpose, location/postcode field and category filters
records.record_scope: official public inspection-report search interface and searchable provider categories

records.excerpt: GOV.UK identifies the Ofsted service as the official route for inspection reports covering childcare providers, schools, colleges, children and families services, and residential holiday schemes for disabled children.
records.web_line_scope: official GOV.UK service summary and Start now link
records.record_scope: official service identity and inspection-report coverage

records.excerpt: An official Ofsted provider page uses the /provider/{type}/{URN} path and displays provider name, category, URN, report dates and, where publishable, contact or address information; PDF reports are separate links and are outside this task scope.
records.web_line_scope: official provider example lines 4-17 and 256-268; provider identity, category, URN/report structure
records.record_scope: official provider-page URL pattern and visible metadata structure only

records.excerpt: Ofsted states that information on its GOV.UK website, excluding logos, may be used and re-used free of charge under the Open Government Licence, with source attribution and a hyperlink.
records.web_line_scope: official guidance lines 55-81; copyright and re-use terms
records.record_scope: official re-use licence and attribution boundary
